name: Reverberations
description: You are a survivor in the zombie apocalypse, your only source of light agianst the monsters of the night is your own gun as you traverse these randomly generated mazes.
notes: Considering how simple the gameplay loop ended up being, I am really happy with how fun this little arcade style game turned out.
The was the final project for my "Intro to Game Web Tech" class.
Looking back at this project reminds me of the days when I thought Javascript was fun to code in, admittedly that's probably because I've just been having more fun making games then websites.
